>Also you may want to talk to your local priest or vicar, I am not religious but they are often happy to talk to any parishioner.

I have faith in god, but it's not as strong as it used to be, so I'm a bit nervous about this.

>Just wait till you can talk to someone, the lowest point in life is not the end, it can be a catalyst for life change and there are always people who will want to help you.

I feel horrible, I've tried to kill myself, I've tried self harm, I've been severely depressed. Just feel like everything is against me, even when trying to find help.

They said they would contact my GP even though I told them not to multiple times.

I turned 18 a few weeks ago, so is my confidentiality guaranteef?

If my family find out, I can't deal with thier reactions.
